title: Nice Partitions, Supersolvability, and Freeness in Deformations of Graphic Arrangements
summary: We study affine deformations $\mathcal{A}(G_{\mathcal{S}})$ of graphic arrangements and their cones. Here $G=([n],E(G))$ is a simple graph, $\mathcal{S}=(S_{ij})$ is a family of finite gain sets, and $\mathcal{A}(G_{\mathcal{S}})$ consists of the hyperplanes $x_i-x_j=a$ with $a\in S_{ij}$. We call $G_{\mathcal{S}}$ blockwise admissible if every block has a vertex ordering $v_1,\ldots,v_m$ satisfying $S_{v_kv_j}-S_{v_kv_i}\subseteq S_{v_iv_j}$ for every $k$ and all distinct $i,j>k$.
